content: {"phoneNote":"The hero card is pushed so far down that the headline only appears mid-screen and the CTA sits right against the fixed bar, while the opening-hours chart shows bars without any hour labels, so the empty gridlines mean nothing.","desktopNote":"The hero works well with the card over the mining-town photo, but the CTA is cut at the fold and the lower half of the page is a wall of navy with a huge empty band and an oversized footer wordmark.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Move the hero card up on phone so address, headline and CTA all sit in the first screen; on desktop pull the card up so 'Kako do nas' is fully visible above the fold.","Give the opening-hours chart its hour scale on phone (or switch to a simple list), and tighten the empty gaps around it.","Reduce the footer wordmark and merge the navy beer, contact and footer blocks with a lighter band or photo so the lower page is not one continuous dark slab."],"blockers":["Phone, hero: the 'Kako do nas' button is nearly covered by the fixed bottom bar.","Phone, opening hours: the timeline bars have no hour labels, so the chart is unreadable."]}
